name: InnoCare Optoelectronics Corporation
summary: InnoCare Optoelectronics Corporation engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of optical instruments and medical devices. It also offers X-ray flat panel detectors sensors for healthcare, veterinary, security, and industrial applications in Taiwan and internationally. It offers thin film transistors and scintillators, and other medical products, as well as accessories, including power and ethernet cables, charger sets, and batteries. InnoCare Optoelectronics Corporation was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
